path.description: [UNSTABLE] Path to the thread on disk.

historyMode.description: Persisted thread history contract selected when this thread was created.

ephemeral.description: Whether the thread is ephemeral and should not be materialized on disk.

originator.description: Originator recorded when the thread was created, independent of its current client or executor. Null when the recorded originator is unavailable.

threadSource.description: Optional analytics source classification for this thread.

source.description: Origin of the thread (CLI, VSCode, codex exec, codex app-server, etc.).

sessionId.description: Session id shared by threads that belong to the same session tree.

ThreadRead_includeTurns.description: When true, include turns and their items from rollout history. Full-history hydration is deprecated for paginated threads; prefer a metadata-only read and page with `thread/turns/list` and `thread/items/list`.

limits: Schema capability only; no active account or task inspected
API schema is not proof of hook JSON or rollout storage format
